annotations.title: Batch OCR: up to 10 files in one call

description: Read the text from up to 10 images, scans or PDFs in one paid call, cheaper than one call per file. Use for a stack of receipts, pages of a scanned letter, photos of forms or a folder of screenshots. Send {files:[{url} or {base64}], lang}. Max 30 pages across the batch, 20 MB per file. Each file gets its own result or error. Returns {files, pages, results:[{index, text, method, pages}]}. Errors: 400 bad input, 422 nothing readable. Price: $0.08 USDC per call (x402).

base64.description: File contents, base64-encoded (max 20 MB). Provide url OR base64.

url.description: Public URL of the file. Provide url OR base64.
